_comment: Backdrops for the journey events. TWO pipelines read this file. tools/art/fetch_scene_art.py reads the 'prompt' on each scene and fetches a generated 1920x1080 painting - that is what ships. tools/art/build_journey_scenes.py composes the same scenes from Kenney CC0 tiles using the bands/props/place fields - kept because it needs no network and works offline, but it reads as a tile grid rather than a place. Render a Kenney tile index with: python.exe tools\art\sheet_grid.py kenney/roguelike-modern-city/Tilemap/tilemap.png --cols 0 36 --rows 0 27 --out art-source/working/city_grid.png
_licensing: MIXED, AND NOT ALL CC0. The tile fields use Kenney Roguelike Modern City 2.0, CC0 per its own License.txt. The 'prompt' fields produce AI-generated images whose training data is undisclosed and whose ownership is legally unsettled - they are NOT CC0 and are recorded under their own heading in LICENSES.md. Do not move them into the CC0 table.
_geometry: Each scene is 20 tiles wide by 12 tall. At 16px and scale 6 that is 1920x1152, which covers the 1920x1080 design resolution with room to pan. Rows are top to bottom. null leaves a tile transparent so a lower layer shows through.
_bands: Most scenes are built from three horizontal bands: a wall or sky band at the top, a detail band (windows, doors, shopfronts) in the middle, and a ground band at the bottom. The band helpers below are expanded by build_journey_scenes.py so a scene only has to name them.
_props: Single tiles dropped on top of a band. Coordinates are (column, row) on the sheet.

SC-HOME-NIGHT._note: A room with one window and a paraffin heater. Where you are born, and where the offer letter is read years later.
SC-HOME-NIGHT.prompt: interior of a small modest Tehran apartment room at night, paraffin heater glowing, one curtained window, patterned rug, warm dim lamplight

SC-HOME-DAY._note: The same room in daylight. Reused deliberately: the journey returns to one room and it is never different.
SC-HOME-DAY.prompt: interior of a small modest Tehran apartment room in daylight, net curtains, patterned rug, low table, bright but soft light

SC-COURTYARD._note: Walled courtyard, a tree, fruit. The only scene in the set with nothing to lose.
SC-COURTYARD.prompt: traditional Iranian walled courtyard in late autumn, shallow turquoise tiled pool, pomegranate tree, brick paving, warm afternoon light

SC-STREET-DAY._note: The four streets a bicycle makes reachable, and the junction at the end of them.
SC-STREET-DAY.prompt: quiet residential street in Tehran, brick and concrete walls, parked cars, plane trees, hazy daylight, mountains faint on the horizon

SC-CLASSROOM._note: Forty children, one decision made in nine seconds.
SC-CLASSROOM.prompt: plain Iranian primary school classroom, rows of worn wooden desks, green chalkboard, tall windows, empty

SC-EXAM-HALL._note: The konkur. Rows and rows of the same desk.
SC-EXAM-HALL.prompt: vast examination hall with hundreds of identical single desks in strict rows, harsh overhead fluorescent light, empty

SC-BARRACKS._note: Where the card is issued, which is not about the army.
SC-BARRACKS.prompt: bare military administrative room, olive green painted walls, metal desk, filing cabinets, single barred window, cold light

SC-CAMPUS._note: A list taped to a wall. Later, the same wall, and the name on the certificate is now a flag.
SC-CAMPUS.prompt: modernist university engineering faculty courtyard in Tehran, concrete and brick, noticeboard, plane trees, clear day

SC-OFFICE._note: Cash in an envelope, counted twice because that is polite.
SC-OFFICE.prompt: cramped small electronics workshop office, circuit boards and tools on benches, cluttered shelves, warm desk lamp

SC-AIRPORT._note: Departures. Used for the easy trip and, much later, for the visit that never happens.
SC-AIRPORT.prompt: airport departures hall, check-in desks, large windows, polished floor, overhead signage blank, empty, cool daylight

SC-AIRPORT-SEC._note: The side of the hall the four letters send you to.
SC-AIRPORT-SEC.prompt: airport secondary screening room, bolted plastic chairs against a blank wall, no clock, harsh fluorescent light, institutional and empty

SC-CONSULATE._note: A counter, a window, and a queue that starts outside. Used for both the Turkish registration and the passport surrender.
SC-CONSULATE.prompt: consular waiting room with a glass service counter, numbered ticket display, rows of empty plastic chairs, flat institutional lighting

SC-REGISTRY._note: Where your name is written down one letter wrong, permanently.
SC-REGISTRY.prompt: civil registry office interior, wooden counter, ledgers and stamp pads, wall of index drawers, dusty afternoon light

SC-BANK._note: A compliance decision arriving at a counter staffed by somebody who did not make it.
SC-BANK.prompt: modern European bank branch interior, glass partitions, service counter, muted corporate blue and grey, empty

SC-PHARMACY.prompt: small Tehran pharmacy interior, white shelves half empty of boxes, glass counter, cold fluorescent light

SC-CHOI-BOOTH._note: The counter itself. One booth, one officer, a line behind you that can hear everything. The room was built to carry sound toward the queue.
SC-CHOI-BOOTH.prompt: immigration inspection booth seen from the queue, high counter, monitor back, glass screen, institutional grey, cold light

SC-CHOI-BACKROOM._note: Secondary inspection. Bolted chairs, no clock, a fraud helpline poster in four languages and none of them yours. Two hours of nothing happening to you on purpose.
SC-CHOI-BACKROOM.prompt: airport secondary inspection holding room, bolted chairs, blank poster frames, locked door, no windows, oppressive fluorescent light

SC-CHOI-DESK._note: Where the refusal is delivered. His desk, his folder, his monitor turned a few degrees - not enough to read, only enough to show you that turning it is his to do.
SC-CHOI-DESK.prompt: small windowless immigration office, metal desk, monitor turned away, folders stacked, single overhead light, cold and bare

SC-DESK-NIGHT._note: Two sentences in an email, read at a desk at night.
SC-DESK-NIGHT.prompt: close view of a cluttered desk at night, laptop screen glow, papers and a cold cup of tea, dark room behind

SC-PEARSON._note: US preclearance at Toronto Pearson. Standing in Canada, at a counter that is legally the United States. The boss arena; dressed but not yet used.
SC-PEARSON.prompt: airport US preclearance hall, queue barriers winding toward inspection booths, overhead signage blank, cold fluorescent light, empty

SC-CHECKPOINT._note: The checkpoint on the way to school, and every journey after it. Cages, turnstiles, a queue that starts before dawn.
SC-CHECKPOINT.prompt: empty military checkpoint terminal at dawn, steel turnstiles and caged walkways, concrete blast walls, floodlights on poles, long empty queueing lane, cold grey light

SC-PERMIT-WINDOW._note: The District Coordination Office window. Where the tasreeh is applied for, and where the answer is usually nothing at all.
SC-PERMIT-WINDOW.prompt: bare government permit office interior, a single service window with thick glass and a metal speaking grille, plastic chairs bolted in a row, fluorescent light, pale institutional walls

SC-OLIVE-GROVE._note: Terraced olive trees older than every document in this story. The harvest, and the one day a year it is allowed.
SC-OLIVE-GROVE.prompt: ancient terraced olive grove on a West Bank hillside, dry stone terraces, gnarled silver-leaved olive trees, nets spread beneath them, hazy warm afternoon light, no people

SC-ALLENBY._note: The King Hussein bridge terminal. The only way out, and it closes without notice.
SC-ALLENBY.prompt: crowded border crossing terminal hall, worn tiled floor, rows of metal benches, luggage scanners, numbered booths behind glass, dusty sunlight through high windows, empty

SC-MIL-COURT._note: A military courtroom inside a base. Nothing references this yet - it is here for the DET category.
SC-MIL-COURT.prompt: small bare military courtroom interior, prefabricated walls, a plain raised bench, folding chairs, a caged dock at one side, strip lighting, olive drab and grey, empty

SC-HOSPITAL-GATE._note: The hospital you can see and the permit you need to reach it.
SC-HOSPITAL-GATE.prompt: entrance forecourt of a modest Middle Eastern public hospital, concrete canopy, ambulance bay, plastic chairs by the doors, worn signage, flat overcast daylight, no people

SC-ROOFTOP-TANKS._note: Black water tanks and solar heaters on a flat roof. Where you go when the power is on six hours a day.
SC-ROOFTOP-TANKS.prompt: flat concrete rooftop crowded with black plastic water tanks and solar water heaters, tangled cables, satellite dishes, low city skyline beyond, dusk light, no people

SC-RUBBLE._note: A house that had a building permit refused, and then had no house.
SC-RUBBLE.prompt: collapsed concrete house reduced to a mound of broken slabs and twisted rebar, domestic debris in the dust, intact houses standing nearby, harsh flat daylight, no people

SC-LAGOS-STREET._note: A main road in Lagos: danfo buses, generators outside every shop, traders on the median.
SC-LAGOS-STREET.prompt: busy Lagos main road seen empty, yellow danfo minibuses parked at the kerb, painted shopfronts with hand-lettered signs, small petrol generators outside each unit, tangled overhead cables, humid hazy daylight

SC-GENERATOR-YARD._note: The compound at night when the grid goes. Where the family sits and where the generator is started.
SC-GENERATOR-YARD.prompt: small walled residential compound at night during a power cut, a petrol generator on a concrete slab, jerrycans, plastic chairs, a single bulb on an extension lead, warm dim light against deep darkness

SC-NYSC-CAMP._note: NYSC orientation camp: the year the state assigns you, in khaki, on a parade ground.
SC-NYSC-CAMP.prompt: empty national youth service orientation camp, dusty parade ground, low whitewashed barrack blocks with green trim, a flagpole, wooden noticeboard, harsh midday light, no people

SC-MATERNITY._note: A public labour ward. Where the cost of the delivery is settled in cash, on the night.
SC-MATERNITY.prompt: public hospital labour ward corridor at night, metal bed frames, worn green curtains on rails, a nurses counter with paper files, fluorescent tubes with one flickering, pale scuffed walls, empty

SC-ROAD-BLOCK._note: The police checkpoint on the expressway that wants twenty naira and will take an hour if it does not get it.
SC-ROAD-BLOCK.prompt: informal police checkpoint on a Nigerian expressway at dusk, oil drums and a plank laid across one lane, worn tyres, a faded signboard, scrub at the roadside, low orange light, no people

SC-PLAZA._note: The plaza of the town you are from. Where the good half of this life happens.
SC-PLAZA.prompt: central plaza of a small Mexican town in the evening, colonial arcades painted ochre and white, laurel trees clipped square, iron benches, a bandstand, string lights not yet lit, warm low sun, no people

SC-BORDER-BRIDGE._note: The international bridge. Turned around here, or waved through, by whoever is in the booth.
SC-BORDER-BRIDGE.prompt: vehicle lanes approaching a US-Mexico international border bridge inspection plaza, steel canopy over booths, lane signals, chain link and razor wire, faded road markings, harsh flat daylight, empty

SC-DESERT._note: The crossing that is counted in bodies. Not romanticised, not staged.
SC-DESERT.prompt: Sonoran desert at first light, creosote scrub and saguaro on stony ground, a dry wash, discarded water bottles and a torn backpack in the foreground, distant ridge, cold dawn light, no people

SC-CONSTRUCTION._note: A roof in July. Where the workplace death rate stops being a statistic.
SC-CONSTRUCTION.prompt: half-framed suburban house under construction on a hot day, bare timber trusses, plywood decking, stacked shingle bundles, an extension ladder against the eave, bleached harsh sunlight, no people

SC-BUS-STATION._note: Put down at the bridge after dark, in a city you have never been to.
SC-BUS-STATION.prompt: bus station forecourt in a Mexican border city at night, concrete apron, a shuttered ticket window, steel benches, sodium lamps making orange pools, closed shopfronts beyond, empty

SC-DETENTION._note: The holding room. Civil detention, which is why there is no right to a lawyer.
SC-DETENTION.prompt: bare immigration holding room interior, painted cinder block walls, a fixed metal bench along one wall, a heavy door with a small window, strip lighting, a wall clock, no furniture otherwise, empty

SC-SUBURB-YARD._note: The back yard of a house with a mortgage on it. Where the good half of the citizen's life happens.
SC-SUBURB-YARD.prompt: back yard of an ordinary North American suburban house in the early evening, clapboard siding, a wooden deck, folding chairs on cut grass, a chain link fence, a maple at the boundary, warm low sun, no people

SC-FREEWAY._note: The commute, and the crash. Built so that not having a car is not an option.
SC-FREEWAY.prompt: wide North American freeway interchange seen from the shoulder, concrete overpasses, lane markings, green overhead direction signs, sound barriers, scrubby verge, flat overcast daylight, no vehicles
